Title: Azure Dedicated Hosts now support additional Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
Azure Dedicated Host provides a single-tenant physical server to host your Azure Virtual Machines for Windows and Linux. The server capacity isn’t shared with other customers. Address specific organizational compliance requirements or plan your maintenance window by deploying your workloads on Dedicated Hosts.

Run M-series, NV v3-series, and NV v4-series virtual machines (VMs) on Dedicated Hosts. New Dedicated Host SKUs featuring new hardware types are now generally available as well. With this update, we continue to expand the range of workloads that you can run on Azure Dedicated Hosts that now also includes memory-intensive and graphics-intensive applications. These new offerings are now generally available.

Learn more
